scope: Thirty frozen-layout raw A/B/A attempts. Paired ROM vs ASM identifies callee effect at these addresses, not cache misses or production qualification.

proof.scope: Frozen-layout diagnostic only. All ELF bytes identical except one aligned literal target word; no RAM or instruction changes.

packaging.sdk_config: QIO40; SDK uses DIO image header then enables quad mode in bootloader

rom.purpose: Frozen-layout rom entropy division diagnostic; not production; no flashing by generator
rom.partition_layout: app0/app1 960 KiB, SPIFFS 256 KiB; flash app only

asm.purpose: Frozen-layout asm entropy division diagnostic; not production; no flashing by generator
asm.partition_layout: app0/app1 960 KiB, SPIFFS 256 KiB; flash app only

initial.scope: Raw decoder only. Task CPU includes charged ISR/instrumentation; Wi-Fi and WebUI remain enabled. No network audio, demux, normalization or PDM. Sequential A/B, not interleaved.
initial.percent_definition: CPU budget = task microseconds / decoded audio duration * 100. Above 100 cannot sustain realtime even without output.

repeated.scope: Raw decoder only. Task CPU includes charged ISR/instrumentation; Wi-Fi and WebUI remain enabled. No network audio, demux, normalization or PDM. Sequential A/B, not interleaved.
repeated.percent_definition: CPU budget = task microseconds / decoded audio duration * 100. Above 100 cannot sustain realtime even without output.

initial.policy: High bitrate relative time gains must exceed small lower-bitrate relative regressions; both 128/192 checked. Exactness/RAM checked separately.

repeated.policy: High bitrate relative time gains must exceed small lower-bitrate relative regressions; both 128/192 checked. Exactness/RAM checked separately.

historical_best.scope: Historical same-profile best tell-inline reference; not an extra physical run in this frozen pair

attribution.scope: Total raw-decoder time difference divided by host operand count, including downstream cache effects. NOT an exclusive helper timer or measured cache-miss count.
